bs.layout_text: Line = the client's balance-sheet line name; the totals are matched by the names Total assets, Total liabilities and Total capital. Amount = the balance as printed (assets, liabilities and capital positive).
bs.rule: Same 1 / 5 thresholds as the Trial Balance. A line name the client words differently is a REVIEW (presentation rename), never an automatic pass.
bs.sel: Balance-sheet accounts: assets, liabilities and capital, from inception to the transition end-date (ITD). Each account is joined to the chart for its FS grouping and FS line item.
steps: Give every upload row its FS grouping and FS line item from the chart
Add up Dr/(Cr) by FS line item (natural sign: assets, liabilities and capital shown positive)
Total capital = capital accounts + income and expense accounts. Total assets must equal total liabilities + total capital (net to zero)
Compare each FS line item to the client's balance sheet: Diff = upload line minus client line
Flag by the Trial Balance thresholds. A line the other side words differently goes to the analyst to match by meaning; the amounts should still agree

cap.layout_text: Line = one of the roll-forward lines listed in the sheet. Amount = the client's figure, distributions shown positive.
cap.rule: A difference over 1 is an ERROR. Check that the capital Trans Types are mapped correctly in the account mapping.
cap.sel: Capital accounts (contributions, distributions, other capital), from inception. Beginning capital is inception to last year end plus last year's income and expense; the year's changes are year to date. Columns used: Ledgerline account, FS line item, Trans Type, Dr/(Cr), GL date.
steps: Keep the capital accounts, split by FS line item (and Trans Type for recallable distributions)
Beginning capital = capital and income/expense balances dated before this fiscal year
Ending capital = beginning + this year's contributions - this year's distributions + this year's net income (+ other capital movements)
Check the ending capital against total capital on the balance sheet (from inception)
Compare each line to the client's schedule of capital; flag a difference over 1 as an ERROR

cf.layout_text: Line = one of the lines listed in the sheet. Amount = the client's figure (cash in positive, cash out negative).
cf.rule: A difference over 1 is an ERROR. Operating + investing + financing = net change in cash; opening cash + net change = closing cash.
cf.sel: All accounts, year to date. Trans Type assigns the section: cost accounts with a purchase = investing out; cost accounts with a return of capital or sale, and realised gains = investing in; borrowings = financing; capital contributions and distributions = financing.
steps: Keep the rows dated inside the current fiscal year
Operating: net income, reverse unrealised and realised gains (the realised result is shown in investing), then add this year's movement of the other balance-sheet accounts
Investing: purchases (cash out), return of capital and sale proceeds (cash in), realised gains
Financing: contributions, distributions, borrowings (drawn positive, repaid negative)
Supplemental: interest lines are listed for the analyst to tag as paid in cash or accrued
Verify: operating + investing + financing = net change in cash on the cash accounts; opening cash + net change = closing cash; then compare to the client's statement

evl.rule: A difference over 1 per account, or |LP total + offset total| over 1, is an ERROR (a missing or duplicate allocation row). Runs only when both runs exist for the entity.
evl.sel: Fund run: capital accounts, ITD. LP run: capital accounts, ITD, investor rows (investor not blank) and the offset rows (investor blank).
steps: Fund total per Ledgerline account from the fund run
LP total (investor not blank) and offset total (investor blank) from the LP run
Offset test: LP total + offset total = 0, per account
Diff = fund total minus LP total (investor rows only), per account, within 1

irr.layout_text: One row per cash flow: Investor, Date (PR_DATE), Amount (contribution negative, distribution positive). Add a row with Line = Ending capital and its Date for each investor's terminal value, and optionally Line = IRR with the percentage in Amount.
irr.rule: Any date mismatch, or a difference over 1, is an ERROR. Uses PR_DATE, not GL date. A PR_DATE that differs from the GL date goes to the analyst (REVIEW).
irr.sel: LP-level upload only. Contribution and distribution accounts, blank-investor rows left out, ITD. PR_DATE is the cash-flow date. Terminal value = each investor's ending capital.
steps: Keep contribution and distribution rows that have an investor
Per investor take (PR_DATE, amount): contributions are cash out (negative), distributions cash in
Add the investor's ending capital balance as the final inflow
Dates must match the client's IRR table exactly; amounts within 1
With the terminal date on the client's table, work out the IRR of the checked flows and compare it with the IRR the client shows
Flag: any date mismatch or amount difference over 1 is an ERROR. PR_DATE different from the GL date (transfers, sub-closings) needs manual review

is.layout_text: Line = the client's income-statement line; the totals are matched by Total revenue, Total expenses and Net income. Amount = the figure for the current fiscal year, shown positive.
is.rule: A difference over 1 is an ERROR. Check the fiscal-year filter first, then the FS line item assignment in the chart / account mapping.
is.sel: Income and expense accounts (FS grouping Revenue or Expenses), year to date: GL date inside the current fiscal year. Columns used: Ledgerline account, FS grouping, FS line item, Dr/(Cr), GL date.
steps: Keep income and expense accounts dated inside the current fiscal year
Add up by FS grouping and FS line item (revenue and expenses shown positive)
Net income = total revenue minus total expenses
Compare line by line to the client's income statement for the same year
Flag a difference over 1 as an ERROR: check the fiscal-year filter, then the FS line item assignment. Net income also feeds the Statement of Cash Flow

pcap.layout_text: Investor = the investor's name or ID. Line = Contributions, Distributions, Other movements, Ending balance or Opening balance. Amount = the client's figure. Period = ITD or YTD (blank = ITD).
pcap.rule: A difference over 1 per investor per bucket is an ERROR
pcap.sel: LP-level upload only. Capital accounts, rows with a blank investor (offsets) left out. ITD for the main check, then this fiscal year's rows for the year-to-date section. Columns used: investor, Ledgerline account, FS line item, Dr/(Cr), GL date.
steps: Keep the capital-account rows that have an investor
Add up by investor and FS line item: contributions, distributions, other movements
Per investor: opening (ITD = 0) + contributions - distributions + other movements = ending balance
Compare each investor's buckets to the client's PCAP
The sum of the investors must equal the fund-level capital total (when the fund run is in the app)
Year to date: the same, on this fiscal year's rows, with the opening balance = prior-year ending

soi.layout_text: Line = investment name. Measure = Cost, Unrealised, Fair value or Shares. Amount = the figure on the client's schedule.
soi.rule: A difference over 1 for amounts, or any share mismatch, is an ERROR. Check the investment mapping for a wrong deal-name link.
soi.sel: Investment cost accounts and fair-value adjustment accounts, ITD. Columns used: Ledgerline account, Investment name, NO_OF_SHARES, Dr/(Cr) amount.
steps: Keep the investment cost and the fair-value adjustment accounts
Add up by investment name: cost (cost accounts), unrealised (fair-value adjustment accounts), shares (on the cost accounts)
Fair market value = cost + unrealised
Compare cost, fair market value and shares per investment to the client's schedule
Flag: over 1 on amounts, or any share mismatch, is an ERROR. A sold position shows zero ending cost: confirm it is still on the client's schedule if their report needs the realised result

tb.layout_text: Line = the client's account (its number or its number and name). Trans Type = the client's transaction type where the mapping needs one. Amount = ending balance, debit positive and credit negative.
tb.rule: |Diff| up to 1 PASS · over 1 up to 5 WARN (likely a topside rounding adjustment) · over 5 ERROR (the TB mapping probably needs correcting: do not bypass it, go back to the previous phase)
tb.sel: All upload rows, no account filter, from inception to the transition end-date (ITD). LP level includes the investor rows and the blank-investor offset rows. Columns used: Ledgerline account, account name, Dr/(Cr) amount, GL date.
steps: Add up the upload by Ledgerline account (debit positive, credit negative)
Take the client's trial balance and resolve each client account (with its Trans Type) to a Ledgerline account through the account mapping
Diff = upload balance minus client balance, account by account
Flag by threshold. If the mapping is corrected, refresh the upload figures and run this again before the Balance Sheet

unf.layout_text: Investor = name or ID. Line = Commitment and Unfunded (one row each per investor). Amount = the client's figure.
unf.rule: A difference over 1 per investor is an ERROR
unf.sel: LP-level upload. Contribution accounts flagged AGNST_COMMIT = Yes, plus distributions whose Trans Type says recallable, ITD. Columns used: investor, AGNST_COMMIT, Trans Type, Dr/(Cr).
steps: Add up contributions called per investor (rows flagged against commitment)
Add up recallable distributions per investor
Take each investor's total commitment from the client's report (the app holds no commitment amounts)
Unfunded = commitment - contributions called + recallable distributions
Compare to the client's PCAP unfunded column; flag a difference over 1 as an ERROR

wf.layout_text: One row per event: Investor, Date (PR_DATE), Trans Type (optional), Amount. A table with dates as columns and investors as rows is read too.
wf.rule: A date or amount mismatch is an ERROR. PR_DATE different from the GL (booking) date is a REVIEW.
wf.sel: LP-level upload. Capital accounts (contributions, distributions, other), blank-investor rows left out, ITD. PR_DATE is the event date. The guide also says "filter to Investment" without saying what that selects, so no such filter is applied; ask the guide's owner.
steps: Keep the capital-account rows that have an investor
Per row take investor, PR_DATE, Trans Type and amount
Add up by investor + PR_DATE + Trans Type
Compare to the client's waterfall support table: dates must match exactly, amounts within 1
List the rows where PR_DATE differs from the GL date for the analyst: a wrong date changes the preferred return and carry
The client's table may have dates across the top and investors down the side; both layouts are read
